name: Iolanthe di Parisi
source:
“Every rose has its thorns.”

A girl who, though she might be able to demonstrate every aspect of being the ideal princess, could have other ideas. Choices at the beginning of the game will determine her personality, from loudmouth tomboy to cunning saboteur, and these will in turn influence the choices you can make in-game.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=40623]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
